title: Alpine
suits: travel, outdoor, sport, wellness, booking and seasonal products; pitches about reaching a peak or a winter launch. Walk data-tod from bright afternoon through alpenglow to a starry night.

params.data-tod: 0 bright afternoon · .5 alpenglow (lit faces turn pink) · 1 night (stars, moon, groomer, lit chalet)
params.--brand: on the section: the skier's jacket, the skis by the chalet door, the summit flag, one in five chairlift riders
params.--brand-2: on the section: the sled, the night groomer, one in five riders
params.--field (set by the scene): the sky behind the headline zone, so --ink-auto stays right

details: snow falls at two depths: small slow flakes far, larger swaying flakes near; thinner over the headline zone
chairs move up one cable and down the other on a 96 s loop, hanging plumb and swaying a little after each tower
one chair rides up empty and swings more than the rest
riders sit in ones and twos in coloured jackets, skis dangling
a skier zigzags down the far snowfield, growing a little as she comes closer, leaning into each turn and leaving a trace that fades before the next run
after dark the skier is gone and a piste groomer crawls up the same run with its headlights on and an amber beacon blinking, leaving corduroy
chalet chimney smoke rises, leans with the breeze, spreads and thins
the chalet's windows light up as the light drops, and a fire flickers behind the ground-floor window
a pair of skis stands in the snow by the chalet door, a sled leans on the wall, footprints lead to the door
alpenglow at tod .5: the sunlit faces turn pink while the shaded faces go violet
rock shows only where the faces are too steep to hold snow
stars appear with the hour; a few on the right twinkle; a thin crescent moon at night
a satellite crosses the night sky every 50 s
a pine by the lift sheds its load of snow every 23 s
a summit flag flutters at the top of the lift; tower lamps come on at night
the lift's bottom station has a lit window and a snow-loaded roof
